hypothesis: The baseline (parent) critical-pair Laplacian backfired because it *adds* a locality term on top of the cut term, letting critical nets be sacrificed to minimize l_loc; instead we keep the exact baseline backbone (cut + 10*balance + bin) and simply *modulate the existing cut probability* by a mild, case-relative criticality factor (1 + alpha*max_pin_crit) so that critical nets are the last to be cut, with alpha small enough not to perturb the low-crit_cross backbone.
